name: Hanon
source:
“Go home. Never come near milady again.”

She is one of Miu’s guardians—a tall, slender, and strikingly beautiful woman who dresses in masculine attire. The restaurant where she works attracts a large number of female fans. Her manner of speaking is also very masculine, and she bluntly says even things that are difficult to voice. She takes pride in serving as Miu’s bodyguard, and her skill with knives is first-rate.
